questions.q: What did Noah offer when he came out of the ark?
choices: A tenth of all he had
Burnt offerings of every clean beast and every clean fowl
questions.explain: The Most High smelled a sweet savour and said He would not curse the ground any more for man's sake.

questions.q: The covenant says all flesh will perish no more by a flood. What does the class say comes next time?
questions.explain: Before it was water; the next time it is going to be fire.

questions.q: What does Genesis 8:2 show the windows of heaven refer to?
questions.explain: The windows of heaven being stopped and the rain restrained shows the windows of heaven refer to the rain.
